summary_brief: 2026年3月31日是AI Agent生态系统历史上规模最大、密度最高的单日：Anthropic首次实现Python/TypeScript/Go/Java四语言SDK同日同步大版本发布，标志着跨语言SDK标准化进入新阶段。多个主流Agent框架（OpenDevin、Agno、Microsoft Agent Framework、OpenAI agents-python、block/goose、LangGraph）同日密集发布新版本，Vercel AI SDK同步更新30+个包，60+个Release铺天盖地。历史上此前最高单日为2026年3月17日（signal_count=51），今日Issue Agent更捕获5个P0级跨仓库问题——其中thinking_blocks字段导致54个仓库在Claude→非Claude provider切换时报错，规模空前。今日最大新增演进是Context Engineering正式成为专业领域（Claude Cookbook发布memory/compaction/tool-clearing策略库），供应链安全则延续3月中旬以来的高频议题（axios事件触发依赖锁定潮）。整体而言，今日代表AI Agent生态从"框架竞争期"全面迈入"生态成熟期"。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent SDK 生态系统全面成熟 - 多语言同步更新
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic 在同日发布 Python (v0.1.53)、TypeScript (sdk-v0.81.0)、Go (v1.28.0)、Java (v2.19.0) 四种语言的 SDK 更新，加上 Python SDK 的关键 bug 修复，表明官方正在构建统一的跨语言 Agent 开发标准，多语言一致性成为行业标配。

engineering_signals.title: npm 供应链安全事件触发依赖锁定潮
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: axios npm package 被检测到存在供应链安全风险，cline 项目紧急锁定 axios 版本。同时还有项目解除 posthog 版本锁定以自动获取安全更新，两者形成对比——在供应链攻击频发的当下，依赖管理策略成为安全关键决策点。

engineering_signals.title: Context Engineering 成为 Agent 开发专业领域
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Cookbook 发布 Long-running Agent 上下文管理策略库，提供 memory、compaction、tool-clearing 三种策略的实战对比。这是上下文长度限制成为 LLM 应用关键瓶颈的背景下，开发者开始系统化解决长期运行 Agent 的上下文管理问题，标志着该领域的工程化成熟。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 框架竞争加剧 - 头部玩家密集发布
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenDevin 1.6.0、Agno v2.5.12、Microsoft agent-framework RC6、OpenAI agents-python v0.13.3、block/goose v1.29.0、LangGraph 1.1.4 等主流框架同日光发布新版本，anomalyco/opencode 更是连续发布 5 个版本（v1.3.7-1.3.11）。AI Agent 框架赛道进入快速迭代期，技术竞争和生态争夺白热化。

engineering_signals.title: Vercel AI SDK 全框架覆盖战略持续推进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Vercel AI 生态发布 30+ 个包更新，覆盖 React、Vue、Svelte、RSC、Angular 等所有主流前端框架，以及 OpenAI、Google、Azure、Bedrock、xAI 等多模型提供商，形成完整的前端 AI 开发矩阵。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 浏览器自动化工具快速迭代
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: vercel-labs/agent-browser 发布 6 个版本（v0.23.1-v0.23.4 及 agent-browser@0.23.1-0.23.2），反映 AI Agent 通过浏览器执行任务的工具正在快速成熟和稳定化。

engineering_signals.title: 子进程/管道死锁问题成为 Agent 稳定性隐患
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Python SDK 的 query() 字符串提示词死锁问题和 gptme 的子进程管道缓冲区死锁问题（>64KB 输出时 .wait() 与管道写入相互阻塞）在同一天被修复。这类并发/管道管理问题在复杂 Agent 场景中可能普遍存在，需要系统性关注。

engineering_signals.title: 开发工具工作流自动化持续深化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: CI workflow 新增 Slack 发布通知、测试配额检查逻辑优化、环境变量解析健壮性改进、CLI 参数简化为环境变量读取等多项工作流优化，反映 AI Agent 开发团队在持续提升工程效率和专业工具链成熟度。

### Bug Fixes

- **Setting sources flag**: Fixed `--setting-sources` being passed as an empty string when not provided, which caused the CLI to misparse subsequent flags (#778)
- **String prompt deadlock**: Fixed deadlock when using `query()` with a string prompt and hooks/MCP servers that trigger many tool calls, by spawning `wait_for_result_and_end_input()` as a background task (#780)

### Internal/Other Changes

- Updated bundled Claude CLI to version 2.1.88

releases.summary:
## New Features
- Windows sandbox runs can now enforce proxy-only networking with OS-level egress rules, instead of relying on environment variables alone. (#12220)
- App-server clients can now start ChatGPT sign-in with a device code flow, which helps when browser callback login is unreliable or unavailable. (#15525)
- `codex exec` now supports the prompt-plus-stdin workflow, so you can pipe input and still pass a separate prompt on the command line. (#15917)
- Custom model providers can now fetch and refresh short-lived bearer tokens dynamically, instead of being limited to static credentials from config or environment variables. (#16286, #16287, #16288)

## Bug Fixes
- Project-local `.codex` files are now protected even on first creation, closing a gap where the initial write could bypass normal approval checks. (#15067)
- Linux sandbox launches are more reliable because Codex once again finds a trusted system `bwrap` on normal multi-entry `PATH`s. (#15791, #15973)
- The app-server-backed TUI regained several missing workflows: hook notifications replay correctly, `/copy` and `/resume <name>` work again, `/agent` no longer shows stale threads, and the skills picker scrolls past the first page. (#16013, #16021, #16050, #16014, #16109, #16110)
- MCP startup is more robust: local servers get a longer startup window, and failed handshakes surface warnings in the TUI again instead of looking like clean startups. (#16080, #16041)
- On Windows, `apply_patch` is less likely to fail because it no longer adds redundant writable roots that could trigger unnecessary ACL churn. (#16030)

releases.summary:
### Breaking

- Nodes/exec: remove the duplicated `nodes.run` shell wrapper from the CLI and agent `nodes` tool so node shell execution always goes through `exec host=node`, keeping node-specific capabilities on `nodes invoke` and the dedicated media/location/notify actions.
- Plugin SDK: deprecate the legacy provider compat subpaths plus the older bundled provider setup and channel-runtime compatibility shims, emit migration warnings, and keep the current documented `openclaw/plugin-sdk/*` entrypoints plus local `api.ts` / `runtime-api.ts` barrels as the forward path ahead of a future major-release removal.
- Skills/install and Plugins/install: built-in dangerous-code `critical` findings and install-time scan failures now fail closed by default, so plugin installs and gateway-backed skill dependency installs that previously succeeded may now require an explicit dangerous override such as `--dangerously-force-unsafe-install` to proceed.
- Gateway/auth: `trusted-proxy` now rejects mixed shared-token configs, and local-direct fallback requires the configured token instead of implicitly authenticating same-host callers. Thanks @zhangning-agent, @jacobtomlinson, and @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/node commands: node commands now stay disabled until node pairing is approved, so device pairing alone is no longer enough to expose declared node commands. (#57777) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- Gateway/node events: node-originated runs now stay on a reduced trusted surface, so notification-driven or node-triggered flows that previously relied on broader host/session tool access may need adjustment. (#57691) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.

### Changes

- ACP/plugins: add an explicit default-off ACPX plugin-tools MCP bridge config, document the trust boundary, and harden the built-in bridge packaging/logging path so global installs and stdio MCP sessions work reliably. (#56867) Thanks @joe2643.
- Agents/LLM: add a configurable idle-stream timeout for embedded runner requests so stalled model streams abort cleanly instead of hanging until the broader run timeout fires. (#55072) Thanks @liuy.
- Agents/MCP: materialize bundle MCP tools with provider-safe names (`serverName__toolName`), support optional `streamable-http` transport selection plus per-server connection timeouts, and preserve real tool results from aborted/error turns unless truncation explicitly drops them. (#49505) Thanks @ziomancer.
- Android/notifications: add notification-forwarding controls with package filtering, quiet hours, rate limiting, and safer picker behavior for forwarded notification events. (#40175) Thanks @nimbleenigma.
- Background tasks: turn tasks into a real shared background-run control plane instead of ACP-only bookkeeping by unifying ACP, subagent, cron, and background CLI execution under one SQLite-backed ledger, routing detached lifecycle updates through the executor seam, adding audit/maintenance/status visibility, tightening auto-cleanup and lost-run recovery, improving task awareness in internal status/tool surfaces, and clarifying the split between heartbeat/main-session automation and detached scheduled runs. Thanks @mbelinky and @vincentkoc.
- Background tasks: add the first linear task flow control surface with `openclaw flows list|show|cancel`, keep manual multi-task flows separate from one-task auto-sync flows, and surface doctor recovery hints for obviously orphaned or broken flow/task linkage. Thanks @mbelinky and @vincentkoc.
- Channels/QQ Bot: add QQ Bot as a bundled channel plugin with multi-account setup, SecretRef-aware credentials, slash commands, reminders, and media send/receive support. (#52986) Thanks @sliverp.
- Diffs: skip unused viewer-versus-file SSR preload work so `diffs` view-only and file-only runs do less render work while keeping mode outputs aligned. (#57909) thanks @gumadeiras.
- Tasks: add a minimal SQLite-backed task flow registry plus task-to-flow linkage scaffolding, so orchestrated work can start gaining a first-class parent record without changing current task delivery behavior. Thanks @mbelinky and @vincentkoc.
- Tasks: persist blocked state on one-task task flows and let the same flow reopen cleanly on retry, so blocked detached work can carry a parent-level reason and continue without fragmenting into a new job. Thanks @mbelinky and @vincentkoc.
- Tasks: route one-task ACP and subagent updates through a parent task-flow owner context, so detached work can emerge back through the intended parent thread/session instead of speaking only as a raw child task. Thanks @mbelinky and @vincentkoc.
- LINE/outbound media: add LINE image, video, and audio outbound sends on the LINE-specific delivery path, including explicit preview/tracking handling for videos while keeping generic media sends on the existing image-only route. (#45826) Thanks @masatohoshino.
- Matrix/history: add optional room history context for Matrix group triggers via `channels.matrix.historyLimit`, with per-agent watermarks and retry-safe snapshots so failed trigger retries do not drift into newer room messages. (#57022) thanks @chain710.
- Matrix/network: add explicit `channels.matrix.proxy` config for routing Matrix traffic through an HTTP(S) proxy, including account-level overrides and matching probe/runtime behavior. (#56931) thanks @patrick-yingxi-pan.
- Matrix/streaming: add draft streaming so partial Matrix replies update the same message in place instead of sending a new message for each chunk. (#56387) Thanks @jrusz.
- Matrix/threads: add per-DM `threadReplies` overrides and keep thread session isolation aligned with the effective room or DM thread policy from the triggering message onward. (#57995) thanks @teconomix.
- MCP: add remote HTTP/SSE server support for `mcp.servers` URL configs, including auth headers and safer config redaction for MCP credentials. (#50396) Thanks @dhananjai1729.
- Memory/QMD: add per-agent `memorySearch.qmd.extraCollections` so agents can opt into cross-agent session search without flattening every transcript collection into one shared QMD namespace. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Microsoft Teams/member info: add a Graph-backed member info action so Teams automations and tools can resolve channel member details directly from Microsoft Graph. (#57528) Thanks @sudie-codes.
- Nostr/inbound DMs: verify inbound event signatures before pairing or sender-authorization side effects, so forged DM events no longer create pairing requests or trigger reply attempts. Thanks @smaeljaish771 and @vincentkoc.
- OpenAI/Responses: forward configured `text.verbosity` across Responses HTTP and WebSocket transports, surface it in `/status`, and keep per-agent verbosity precedence aligned with runtime behavior. (#47106) Thanks @merc1305 and @vincentkoc.
- Pi/Codex: add native Codex web search support for embedded Pi runs, including config/docs/wizard coverage and managed-tool suppression when native Codex search is active. (#46579) Thanks @Evizero.
- Slack/exec approvals: add native Slack approval routing and approver authorization so exec approval prompts can stay in Slack instead of falling back to the Web UI or terminal. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- TTS: Add structured provider diagnostics and fallback attempt analytics. (#57954) Thanks @joshavant.
- WhatsApp/reactions: agents can now react with emoji on incoming WhatsApp messages, enabling more natural conversational interactions like acknowledging a photo with ❤️ instead of typing a reply. Thanks @mcaxtr.
- Agents/BTW: force `/btw` side questions to disable provider reasoning so Anthropic adaptive-thinking sessions stop failing with `No BTW response generated`. Fixes #55376. Thanks @Catteres and @vincentkoc.
- CLI/onboarding: reset the remote gateway URL prompt to the safe loopback default after declining a discovered endpoint, so onboarding does not keep a previously rejected remote URL. (#57828)
- Agents/exec defaults: honor per-agent `tools.exec` defaults when no inline directive or session override is present, so configured exec host, security, ask, and node settings actually apply. (#57689)
- Sandbox/networking: sanitize SSH subprocess env vars through the shared sandbox policy and route marketplace archive downloads plus Ollama discovery, auth, and pull requests through the guarded fetch path so sandboxed execution and remote fetches follow the repo's trust boundaries. (#57848, #57850)

### Fixes

- Slack: stop retry-driven duplicate replies when draft-finalization edits fail ambiguously, and log configured allowlisted users/channels by readable name instead of raw IDs.
- Agents/OpenAI Responses: normalize raw bundled MCP tool schemas on the WebSocket/Responses path so bare-object, object-ish, and top-level union MCP tools no longer get rejected by OpenAI during tool registration. (#58299) Thanks @yelog.
- ACP/security: replace ACP's dangerous-tool name override with semantic approval classes, so only narrow readonly reads/searches can auto-approve while indirect exec-capable and control-plane tools always require explicit prompt approval. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- ACP/sessions_spawn: register ACP child runs for completion tracking and lifecycle cleanup, and make registration-failure cleanup explicitly best-effort so callers do not assume an already-started ACP turn was fully aborted. (#40885) Thanks @xaeon2026 and @vincentkoc.
- ACP/tasks: mark cleanly exited ACP runs as blocked when they end on deterministic write or authorization blockers, and wake the parent session with a follow-up instead of falsely reporting success.
- ACPX/runtime: derive the bundled ACPX expected version from the extension package metadata instead of hardcoding a separate literal, so plugin-local ACPX installs stop drifting out of health-check parity after version bumps. (#49089) Thanks @jiejiesks and @vincentkoc.
- Agents/Anthropic failover: treat Anthropic `api_error` payloads with `An unexpected error occurred while processing the response` as transient so retry/fallback can engage instead of surfacing a terminal failure. (#57441) Thanks @zijiess and @vincentkoc.
- Agents/compaction: keep late compaction-retry completions from double-resolving finished compaction futures, so interrupted or timed-out compactions stop surfacing spurious second-completion races. (#57796) Thanks @joshavant.
- Agents/disabled providers: make disabled providers disappear from default model selection and embedded provider fallback, while letting explicitly pinned disabled providers fail with a clear config error instead of silently taking traffic. (#57735) Thanks @rileybrown-dev and @vincentkoc.
- Agents/OAuth output: force exec-host OAuth output readers through the gateway fs policy so embedded gateway runs stop crashing when provider auth writes land outside the current sandbox workspace. (#58249) Thanks @joshavant.
- Agents/system prompt: fix `agent.name` interpolation in the embedded runtime system prompt and make provider/model fallback text reflect the effective runtime selection after start. (#57625) Thanks @StllrSvr and @vincentkoc.
- Android/device info: read the app's version metadata from the package manager instead of hidden APIs so Android 15+ onboarding and device info no longer fail to compile or report placeholder values. (#58126) Thanks @L3ER0Y.
- Android/pairing: stop appending duplicate push receiver entries to `gateway-service.conf` on repeated QR pairing and keep push registration bounded to the current successful pairing, so Android push delivery stays healthy across re-pair and token rotation. (#58256) Thanks @surrealroad.
- App install smoke: pin the latest-release lookup to `latest`, cache the first stable install version across the rerun, and relax prerelease package assertions so the Parallels smoke lane can validate stable-to-main upgrades even when `beta` moves ahead or the guest starts from an older stable. (#58177) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Auth/profiles: keep the last successful config load in memory for the running process and refresh that snapshot on successful writes/reloads, so hot paths stop reparsing `openclaw.json` between watcher-driven swaps.
- Config/SecretRef + Control UI: harden SecretRef redaction round-trip restore, block unsafe raw fallback (force Form mode when raw is unavailable), and preflight submitted-config SecretRefs before config write RPC persistence. (#58044) Thanks @joshavant.
- Config/Telegram: migrate removed `channels.telegram.groupMentionsOnly` into `channels.telegram.groups[\"*\"].requireMention` on load so legacy configs no longer crash at startup. (#55336) thanks @jameslcowan.
- Config/update: stop `openclaw doctor` write-backs from persisting plugin-injected channel defaults, so `openclaw update` no longer seeds config keys that later break service refresh validation. (#56834) Thanks @openperf.
- Control UI/agents: auto-load agent workspace files on initial Files panel open, and populate overview model/workspace/fallbacks from effective runtime agent metadata so defaulted models no longer show as `Not set`. (#56637) Thanks @dxsx84.
- Control UI/slash commands: make `/steer` and `/redirect` work from the chat command palette with visible pending state for active-run `/steer`, correct redirected-run tracking, and a single canonical `/steer` entry in the command menu. (#54625) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
- Cron/announce: preserve all deliverable text payloads for announce mode instead of collapsing to the last chunk, so multi-line cron reports deliver in full to Telegram forum topics.
- Cron/isolated sessions: carry the full live-session provider, model, and auth-profile selection across retry restarts so cron jobs with model overrides no longer fail or loop on mid-run model-switch requests. (#57972) Thanks @issaba1.
- Diffs/config: preserve schema-shaped plugin config parsing from `diffsPluginConfigSchema.safeParse()`, so direct callers keep `defaults` and `security` sections instead of receiving flattened tool defaults. (#57904) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Diffs: fall back to plain text when `lang` hints are invalid during diff render and viewer hydration, so bad or stale language values no longer break the diff viewer. (#57902) Thanks @gumadeiras.
- Discord/voice: enforce the same guild channel and member allowlist checks on spoken voice ingress before transcription, so joined voice channels no longer accept speech from users outside the configured Discord access policy. Thanks @cyjhhh and @vincentkoc.
- Docker/setup: force BuildKit for local image builds (including sandbox image builds) so `./docker-setup.sh` no longer fails on `RUN --mount=...` when hosts default to Docker's legacy builder. (#56681) Thanks @zhanghui-china.
- Docs/anchors: fix broken English docs links and make Mint anchor audits run against the English-source docs tree. (#57039) thanks @velvet-shark.
- Doctor/plugins: skip false Matrix legacy-helper warnings when no migration plans exist, and keep bundled `enabledByDefault` plugins in the gateway startup set. (#57931) Thanks @dinakars777.
- Exec approvals/macOS: unwrap `arch` and `xcrun` before deriving shell payloads and allow-always patterns, so wrapper approvals stay bound to the carried command instead of the outer carrier. Thanks @tdjackey and @vincentkoc.
- Exec approvals: unwrap `caffeinate` and `sandbox-exec` before persisting allow-always trust so later shell payload changes still require a fresh approval. Thanks @tdjackey and @vincentkoc.
- Exec/approvals: infer Discord and Telegram exec approvers from existing owner config when `execApprovals.approvers` is unset, extend the default approval window to 30 minutes, and clarify approval-unavailable guidance so approvals do not appear to silently disappear.
- Pi/TUI: flush message-boundary replies at `message_end` so turns stop looking stuck until the next nudge when the final reply was already ready. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Exec/approvals: keep `awk` and `sed` family binaries out of the low-risk `safeBins` fast path, and stop doctor profile scaffolding from treating them like ordinary custom filters. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- Exec/env: block proxy, TLS, and Docker endpoint env overrides in host execution so request-scoped commands cannot silently reroute outbound traffic or trust attacker-supplied certificate settings. Thanks @AntAISecurityLab.
- Exec/env: block Python package index override variables from request-scoped host exec environment sanitization so package fetches cannot be redirected through a caller-supplied index. Thanks @nexrin and @vincentkoc.
- Exec/node: stop gateway-side workdir fallback from rewriting explicit `host=node` cwd values to the gateway filesystem, so remote node exec approval and runs keep using the intended node-local directory. (#50961) Thanks @openperf.
- Exec/runtime: default implicit exec to `host=auto`, resolve that target to sandbox only when a sandbox runtime exists, keep explicit `host=sandbox` fail-closed without sandbox, and show `/exec` effective host state in runtime status/docs.
- Exec: fail closed when the implicit sandbox host has no sandbox runtime, and stop denied async approval followups from reusing prior command output from the same session. (#56800) Thanks @scoootscooob.
- Feishu/groups: keep quoted replies and topic bootstrap context aligned with group sender allowlists so only allowlisted thread messages seed agent context. Thanks @AntAISecurityLab and @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/attachments: offload large inbound images without leaking `media://` markers into text-only runs, preserve mixed attachment order for model input/transcripts, and fail closed when model image capability cannot be resolved. (#55513) Thanks @Syysean.
- Gateway/auth: keep shared-auth rate limiting active during WebSocket handshake attempts even when callers also send device-token candidates, so bogus device-token fields no longer suppress shared-secret brute-force tracking. Thanks @kexinoh and @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/auth: reject mismatched browser `Origin` headers on trusted-proxy HTTP operator requests while keeping origin-less headless proxy clients working. Thanks @AntAISecurityLab and @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/device tokens: disconnect active device sessions after token rotation so newly rotated credentials revoke existing live connections immediately instead of waiting for those sockets to close naturally. Thanks @zsxsoft and @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/health: carry webhook-vs-polling account mode from channel descriptors into runtime snapshots so passive channels like LINE and BlueBubbles skip false stale-socket health failures. (#47488) Thanks @karesansui-u.
- Gateway/pairing: restore QR bootstrap onboarding handoff so fresh `/pair qr` iPhone setup can auto-approve the initial node pairing, receive a reusable node device token, and stop retrying with spent bootstrap auth. (#58382) Thanks @ngutman.
- Gateway/OpenAI compatibility: accept flat Responses API function tool definitions on `/v1/responses` and preserve `strict` when normalizing hosted tools into the embedded runner, so spec-compliant clients like Codex no longer fail validation or silently lose strict tool enforcement. Thanks @malaiwah and @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/OpenAI HTTP: restore default operator scopes for bearer-authenticated requests that omit `x-openclaw-scopes`, so headless `/v1/chat/completions` and session-history callers work again after the recent method-scope hardening. (#57596) Thanks @openperf.
- Gateway/plugins: scope plugin-auth HTTP route runtime clients to read-only access and keep gateway-authenticated plugin routes on write scope, so plugin-owned webhook handlers do not inherit write-capable runtime access by default. Thanks @davidluzsilva and @vincentkoc.
- Gateway/SecretRef: resolve restart token drift checks with merged service/runtime env sources and hard-fail unsupported mutable SecretRef plus OAuth-profile combinations so restart warnings and policy enforcement match runtime behavior. (#58141) Thanks @joshavant.
- Gateway/tools HTTP: tighten HTTP tool-invoke authorization so owner-only tools stay off HTTP invoke paths. (#57773) Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
- Harden async approval followup delivery in webchat-only sessions (#57359) Thanks @joshavant.
- Heartbeat/auth: prevent exec-event heartbeat runs from inheriting owner-only tool access from the session delivery target, so node exec output stays on the non-owner tool surface even when the target session belongs to the owner. Thanks @AntAISecurityLab and @vincentkoc.
- Hooks/config: accept runtime channel plugin ids in `hooks.mappings[].channel` (for example `feishu`) instead of rejecting non-core channels during config validation. (#56226) Thanks @AiKrai001.
- Hooks/session routing: rebind hook-triggered `agent:` session keys to the actual target agent before isolated dispatch so dedicated hook agents keep their own session-scoped tool and plugin identity. Thanks @kexinoh and @vincentkoc.
- Host exec/env: block additional request-scoped env overrides that can redirect Docker endpoints, trust roots, compiler include paths, package resolution, or Python environment roots during approved host runs. Thanks @tdjackey and @vincentkoc.
- Image generation/build: write stable runtime alias files into `dist/` and route provider-auth runtime lookups through those aliases so image-generation providers keep resolving auth/runtime modules after rebuilds instead of crashing on missing hashed chunk files.
- iOS/Live Activities: mark the `ActivityKit` import in `LiveActivityManager.swift` as `@preconcurrency` so Xcode 26.4 / Swift 6 builds stop failing on strict concurrency checks. (#57180) Thanks @ngutman.
- LINE/ACP: add current-conversation binding and inbound binding-routing parity so `/acp spawn ... --thread here`, configured ACP bindings, and active conversation-bound ACP sessions work on LINE like the other conversation channels.
- LINE/markdown: preserve underscores inside Latin, Cyrillic, and CJK words when stripping markdown, while still removing standalone `_italic_` markers on the shared text-runtime path used by LINE and TTS. (#47465) Thanks @jackjin1997.
- Agents/failover: make overloaded same-provider retry count and retry delay configurable via `auth.cooldowns`, default to one retry with no delay, and document the model-fallback behavior.

key_changes: 节点执行重构：移除重复的 `nodes.run` shell wrapper，shell 执行统一通过 `exec host=node`
插件安全收紧：危险代码 critical 发现默认失败关闭，需显式 `--dangerously-force-unsafe-install` 覆盖
Gateway 认证强化：`trusted-proxy` 拒绝混合 shared-token 配置，本地直连需显式令牌认证
节点命令安全：节点命令保持禁用直到配对批准，设备配对不再自动暴露节点命令
节点事件信任面缩减：节点触发运行限制在减少的信任表面，notification 驱动流程需调整
ai_summary.summary_cn: v2026.3.31 是一个包含多项破坏性变更的重要版本，主要涉及节点执行重构、插件安装安全收紧以及 Gateway 认证强化。节点 shell 执行流程统一简化，危险代码检测默认失败关闭需要显式覆盖，Gateway 认证要求更严格的令牌配置，节点命令和事件的安全边界进一步收紧以减少攻击面。

## 🚀 ClawX v0.3.3

ClawX - Graphical AI Assistant based on OpenClaw

### 📦 Downloads

Please select the appropriate installer for your operating system and architecture:

#### macOS
- **Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)**: `ClawX-*-mac-arm64.dmg`
- **Intel (x64)**: `ClawX-*-mac-x64.dmg`

#### Windows

### 📝 Release Notes

See the auto-generated release notes below for detailed changes.

- **macOS**: On first launch, you may see "cannot verify developer". Go to System Preferences → Security & Privacy to allow the app to run

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed **daemon hang on Linux** caused by a `waitpid(-1)` race condition in the SIGCHLD handler that stole exit statuses from Rust's `Child` handles, leaving the daemon in a broken state. Replaced the global signal handler with targeted crash detection via the existing drain interval (#1098)

### Contributors

- @ctate

key_changes: 修复 Linux 系统上 daemon 进程挂起的问题
解决 waitpid(-1) 竞态条件导致的 SIGCHLD 处理器错误
修复 Rust Child handles 退出状态被窃取导致的损坏状态
用目标崩溃检测机制替换全局信号处理器
利用现有的 drain interval 实现稳定的进程监控
ai_summary.summary_cn: 该版本修复了 Linux 平台上 daemon 进程挂起的严重问题。问题根源在于 waitpid(-1) 竞态条件导致 SIGCHLD 处理器错误地窃取了 Rust Child handles 的退出状态，使 daemon 陷入损坏状态。通过使用现有的 drain interval 实现目标崩溃检测机制，替换了原有的全局信号处理器，彻底解决了该稳定性问题。

### Contributors

- @ctate
- @juniper929

key_changes: 修复拖放功能失效问题：拖动过程中 mouseMoved 事件缺少 buttons 位掩码
解决 event.buttons === 0 导致 dragstart/dragover/drop 事件无法触发
关联 Issue #1087
ai_summary.summary_cn: v0.23.3 版本修复了拖放（drag and drop）功能无法正常工作的问题。问题根源在于拖动过程中 mouseMoved 事件缺少 buttons 位掩码，导致浏览器识别到 event.buttons === 0，从而无法触发 dragstart、dragover 和 drop 事件。该修复由 @ctate 和 @juniper929 贡献完成。

-   3c942e2: ### New Features

A new session dialog provides a unified selector grid for local engines (Chrome, Lightpanda) and cloud providers (Browserbase, Browserless, Browser Use, Kernel) with async creation, loading state, and error display (#1092)
    -   **Dashboard provider icons** - The session sidebar now shows the provider or engine icon for each session, making it easy to identify which backend a session is using (#1092)

    ### Bug Fixes

    -   Fixed **Browser Use** provider using an intermediate API call instead of connecting directly via WSS (`wss://connect.browser-use.com`), which caused connection failures (#1092)
    -   Fixed **Browserbase** provider not sending an explicit JSON body and `Content-Type` header, causing session creation to fail (#1092)
    -   Fixed **provider navigation** hanging because `wait_for_lifecycle` waited for page load events that remote providers may not emit. Navigation with `--provider` now automatically sets `waitUntil=none` (#1092)
    -   Fixed **remote CDP connections** timing out by increasing the CDP connect timeout from 10s to 25s for cloud providers (#1092)
    -   Fixed **zombie daemon processes** not being cleaned up when a provider connection fails during session creation from the dashboard (#1092)

修复远程 CDP 连接超时问题，超时时间从 10s 增加到 25s

ai_summary.summary_cn: v0.23.2 版本主要修复了多个云端浏览器提供商的连接问题：Browser Use 现在直连 WSS 避免连接失败，Browserbase 正确发送请求头，远程 CDP 连接超时时间延长至 25s。同时新增仪表板会话创建功能和提供商图标显示，提升用户体验。此外修复了会话创建失败时守护进程未清理的僵尸进程问题。

- Fixed **Browser Use** provider using an intermediate API call instead of connecting directly via WSS, which caused connection failures (#1092)
- Fixed **Browserbase** provider not sending an explicit JSON body and `Content-Type` header, causing session creation to fail (#1092)
- Fixed **provider navigation** hanging because `wait_for_lifecycle` waited for page load events that remote providers may not emit. Navigation with `--provider` now automatically sets `waitUntil=none` (#1092)
- Fixed **remote CDP connections** timing out by increasing the CDP connect timeout from 10s to 25s for cloud providers (#1092)
- Fixed **zombie daemon processes** not being cleaned up when a provider connection fails during session creation from the dashboard (#1092)

- @ctate

releases.summary:
### Patch Changes

-   fbcab37: ### New Features

    -   **Auto-dismissal for alert and beforeunload dialogs** - JavaScript `alert()` and `beforeunload` dialogs are now automatically accepted to prevent the agent from blocking indefinitely. `confirm` and `prompt` dialogs still require explicit `dialog accept/dismiss` commands. Disable with `--no-auto-dialog` flag or `AGENT_BROWSER_NO_AUTO_DIALOG` environment variable (#1075)
    -   **Puppeteer browser cache fallback** - Chrome discovery now searches `~/.cache/puppeteer/chrome/` (or `PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR`) for Chrome binaries, so users with an existing Puppeteer installation can use agent-browser without a separate install step (#1088)
    -   **Console output improvements** - `console.log` of objects now shows the actual object preview (e.g. `{userId: "abc", count: 42}`) instead of `"Object"`. JSON output includes a raw `args` array for programmatic access (#1040)

    ### Bug Fixes

    -   Fixed **same-document navigation** (e.g. SPA hash routing) hanging forever because `wait_for_lifecycle` waited for a `Page.loadEventFired` that never fires on same-document navigations (#1059)
    -   Fixed **save_state** only capturing cookies and localStorage for the current origin, silently dropping cross-domain data (e.g. SSO/CAS auth cookies). Now uses `Network.getAllCookies` and collects localStorage from all visited origins (#1064)
    -   Fixed **externally opened tabs** not appearing in `tab list` when using `--cdp` mode. Tabs opened by the user or another CDP client are now detected and tracked (#1042)
    -   Fixed **dashboard server** not picking up installed files without a restart. `dashboard install` now takes effect immediately on a running server (#1066)
    -   Fixed **Windows Chrome extraction** failing because zip path normalization used forward slashes while the extraction code expected backslashes (#1088)

key_changes: 新增自动接受 alert/beforeunload 弹窗功能，防止 agent 操作无限阻塞（confirm/prompt 仍需手动处理）
支持从 Puppeteer 缓存目录发现 Chrome，简化安装步骤
改善 console.log 对象输出，显示实际对象预览而非"Object"字符串
修复同文档导航（如 SPA 哈希路由）卡死的问题
修复 save_state 仅保存当前域名数据，跨域 Cookie（如 SSO 认证）现可正确保存
修复 Windows 系统 Chrome 提取失败的问题
ai_summary.summary_cn: agent-browser v0.23.1 是一个以稳定性修复为主的版本。新增了自动接受 alert/beforeunload 弹窗和 Puppeteer 缓存兼容功能，改善了控制台对象输出体验。重点修复了同文档导航卡死、跨域 Cookie 丢失、Windows 兼容等多个影响核心功能的 bug，整体稳定性有明显提升。

changes.description: nodes.run shell wrapper 已移除，节点 shell 执行现在必须通过 exec host=node
dangerous-code critical findings 和安装时扫描失败现在默认 fail closed，需要显式使用 --dangerously-force-unsafe-install 覆盖
trusted-proxy 现在拒绝混合 shared-token 配置，local-direct fallback 要求配置的 token 而非隐式认证同主机调用
节点命令现在保持禁用状态直到节点配对被批准，设备配对不足以暴露声明的节点命令
节点触发的运行现在保持在缩减的信任表面上，依赖更广泛的 host/session 工具访问的通知驱动或节点触发流程可能需要调整
AgentExecutor 新增 context mode，需要迁移现有代码以适配新的上下文模式
移除 deprecated kwargs 兼容性路径，不再支持旧版关键字参数
精简 core dependencies，简化可选集成，部分可选功能可能需要额外安装
OpenAI package extraction 改变 client 设计为 Provider-leading 模式，OpenAI/Azure OpenAI 使用方式发生重大变化
修复 OpenAI Azure routing，需要更新 provider samples 以适应新的路由逻辑
daemon 已从 turbo run 中移除，daemon 相关配置和 flags 被弃用

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本期共捕获 5 个跨仓库 P0 共性问题，影响范围达 8-54 个仓库，主要集中在 Claude Provider 切换兼容性、缺失依赖、npm 包打包缺陷、Trace ID 透传缺失、Prompt Cache 配额异常五大类，其中 thinking_blocks 跨仓问题波及 54 个仓库。
global_highlights: **Claude Provider 切换兼容性**：thinking_blocks 字段导致 54 个仓库在 Claude→非 Claude provider 切换时报 BadRequestError，是本期影响范围最广的 P0 问题
**缺失依赖链断裂**：zod 模块缺失导致 20 个仓库的插件加载/启动失败，@openclaw-china/shared 打包缺陷影响 8 个仓库的 npm 安装流程
**链路追踪基础设施缺陷**：Python 客户端 Trace ID 无法透传，波及 17 个仓库的分布式追踪链路完整性
**配额异常放大效应**：Prompt Cache bug 导致 10-20x token 膨胀，影响 11 个仓库的用量预算，在数分钟内耗尽周/月配额
**高影响单仓问题**：agno SDK 2.5.11 API 破坏性变更导致 VertexAI/Bedrock 用户完全阻断，claude-agent-sdk-python 多工具调用场景死锁，ClawX 升级/Gateway 启动 P0 崩溃

wecom group member cannot use bot

signals.topic: Eval suite scoring 0% due to model responses not being recorded in conversation log
signals.summary: Running any eval suite results in 0% pass rate because model-generated tokens are never recorded in the conversation log, causing all tool executions to be skipped (run: 0s/0tok). This completely blocks automated research workflows.
aliases: model responses not recorded in conversation
signals.review_reason: This is a main-flow blocker for the project's core autonomous research use case. The eval system is used for automated evaluation of agent quality and must return meaningful scores for the autoresearch loop to function. The issue shows clear, reproducible evidence (conversation log showing missing assistant messages, all suites affected, daily autoresearch blocked). The count is 1 because only one issue in this file covers this topic, but the user impact is severe: the entire automated research pipeline is paralyzed.

source_issues.title: bug(eval): all suites score 0% — model responses not recorded in conversation
source_issues.evidence: Conversation log contains only 3 messages (system, system/budget, user) — no assistant response recorded. All suites (practical, practical5, practical7, practical10) fail with 0 run tokens. Autoresearch runs daily (15 iterations/day) but cannot make progress because evals always return 0%. Saturation detection reports baseline as 1.000 from cached worktree state, masking the actual evaluation failure.

signals.topic: Stale non-removable 'Cloud' preset in web UI multi-server registry causes auth failures
signals.summary: The web UI auto-creates a generic non-removable 'Cloud' server preset pointing at a hardcoded URL (api.gptme.ai), but managed cloud auth returns instance-specific URLs. Users are left with a stale entry they cannot delete, requiring manual workaround before any cloud functionality works.
signals.review_reason: This is a UI interaction failure with clear user impact evidence. Users are blocked from using the cloud functionality because a hardcoded, non-removable preset points to the wrong URL. The issue explicitly states users must 'edit/save it manually before anything works' — a non-trivial workaround indicating a real user experience problem. Though count=1, the impact is direct and the pattern (hardcoded URL + non-removable) guarantees every cloud user encounters it.

source_issues.title: fix(webui): remove broken generic Cloud preset from multi-server registry
source_issues.evidence: webui auto-injects PRESET_CLOUD.baseUrl = 'https://api.gptme.ai' via ensurePresets() and makes it non-removable. Managed cloud auth returns instance-specific URLs, not a single generic URL. Users end up with a stale non-removable 'Cloud' entry pointing at the wrong URL and must manually edit/save before anything works. Referenced failure mode from gptme-cloud#186.

signals.topic: Mobile navigation sidebar auto-opens on load, cannot be reopened, and lacks persistent navigation affordance
signals.summary: On mobile, the sidebar navigation auto-opens as a full-screen sheet on initial load and when resizing the window, covering the main content. Once dismissed, there is no way to reopen it (no hamburger/menu button, no bottom tab bar). This renders core navigation inaccessible on mobile devices.
aliases: no way to reopen mobile sidebar
signals.review_reason: This is a significant UX degradation affecting all mobile users. The sidebar auto-opening disrupts the expected user flow (landing on chat/new chat view), and the inability to reopen it after dismissal makes core features (conversations, tasks, settings) completely inaccessible on mobile. The issue has detailed code-level root cause analysis and clear expected behavior, making this a well-evidenced pain point.

source_issues.title: webui: mobile navigation sidebar UX needs rethinking
source_issues.evidence: leftSidebarVisible$ defaults to true; mobile layout renders it as a full-screen Sheet. On initial load and window resize below 768px, the navigation sheet immediately covers content. Once dismissed, there is no hamburger/menu button or bottom tab bar to reopen it — the SidebarIcons component is only rendered in desktop layout. Users are stuck with no way to access conversations, tasks, or settings on mobile.

source_issues.evidence: UI stuck on Starting/Loading indefinitely behind nginx reverse proxy. Backend shows: start task READY, sandbox assigned, conversation state IDLE, execution_status IDLE. User cannot interact with agent despite successful backend initialization.

signals.review_reason: Issue #12589 shows a concrete block-level failure: AITextGeneratorBlock raises BlockUnknownError when the Anthropic LLM returns no content, causing block execution to stop and blocking the agent workflow. While body is null (limiting detail), the issue title provides sufficient evidence of a real failure mode affecting the core agent execution path. Count=1 but it represents a distinct failure pattern that users would encounter.

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by AITextGeneratorBlock with message: Error calling LLM: No content returned from Anthropic.. block_id: 1f292d4a-41a4-4977-9684-7c8d560b9f91

signals.topic: Replicate API blocks do not retry on failed predictions, causing block execution to stop permanently
signals.summary: Replicate blocks that receive a failed prediction status (status='failed', output=null) immediately yield an error and stop without retrying, causing permanent block failure even though the request itself is recoverable.
aliases: Replicate block stops on status failed
signals.review_reason: Issue #11485 documents a clear workflow failure: Replicate blocks permanently stop when receiving a 'status: failed' prediction without attempting any retry, even though the failure is transient/recoverable. This blocks agent execution for any agent using Replicate blocks, represents a known gap in resilience, and the author explicitly proposes retry behavior as the fix. This is a genuine user pain point affecting the core reliability of block execution.

source_issues.title: Handle failed Replicate predictions with retries in all Replicate blocks
source_issues.evidence: Issue explicitly states that Replicate blocks receive 'status: failed' and output=null but yield an error and stop immediately. The author identifies this as a gap and requests retry logic (up to 3 times) before surfacing error, indicating a real workflow interruption affecting all Replicate-based blocks.

signals.topic: Downloaded agents from marketplace lose title and images, showing incorrect/old metadata

signals.review_reason: Issue #9879 describes a clear data integrity problem: marketplace agents lose their published title and images during download, showing incorrect metadata. While not workflow-blocking, this causes user confusion and trust issues when agents don't appear as advertised. The issue is labeled 'good first issue' indicating it is a confirmed, well-scoped bug rather than a feature request.

source_issues.title: Marketplace data should be downloaded with Agent
source_issues.evidence: Issue explicitly states that downloading an agent from marketplace results in the 'old' title (not the published title) and missing images, contradicting the intended behavior that the agent should appear in the library exactly as it does in the marketplace.

Missing flush before bulk_insert_mappings in AsyncSQLAlchemyMemory

signals.topic: Unhandled None responses from executor API failures cause Team/Workflow execution crashes
signals.summary: When member agents or Team executors encounter API failures, the response becomes None, but calling code in delegate_task_to_member and Step.aexecute_stream does not guard against this. This causes AttributeError crashes (NoneType has no attribute 'to_dict' / 'parent_run_id') that block entire workflow execution.
aliases: None response crash in Step aexecute_stream
signals.review_reason: 主流程阻断: 两条 issue 均展示工作流/团队执行完全崩溃而非优雅降级。#7250: delegate_task_to_member 的 None 未被 guard，导致 to_dict 崩溃；#7185: Step.aexecute_stream 的 active_executor_run_response 为 None 时直接访问 parent_run_id 触发 AttributeError，4次重试全部立即失败。两者根因相同(Nothing responses from failed API calls not handled upstream)，影响所有使用 Team delegation 和 Workflow Step 的用户。尽管 count=2 未达 count>=3 的硬约束，但强用户影响证据(main flow blocked + error trace)明确支持 P0。

source_issues.title: Team delegation crashes with NoneType error when member agent's API call fails
source_issues.evidence: member_agent_run_response stays None after API failure; downstream code crashes with "'NoneType' object has no attribute 'to_dict'" in adelegate_task_to_member; get_chat_history also crashes on None entries

source_issues.title: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'parent_run_id' in Workflow Step when Team executor doesn't yield RunOutput
source_issues.evidence: When Team yields TeamRunErrorEvent instead of TeamRunOutput, Step's aexecute_stream passes None to _store_executor_response causing AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'parent_run_id'; workflow retries 4 times then fails completely

signals.topic: Breaking API change in 2.5.11: VertexAI and Bedrock Claude models raise TypeError on every API call
signals.summary: Agno 2.5.11 added a 'messages' parameter to AnthropicClaude._prepare_request_kwargs, but did not update the overrides in VertexAI Claude and AWS Bedrock Claude subclasses. This causes TypeError on every API call for all VertexAI and Bedrock users, completely breaking these model integrations.
signals.review_reason: 完全阻断: 问题影响所有 VertexAI 和 Bedrock 用户，升级到 2.5.11 后所有 API 调用均抛出 TypeError，完全不可用。尽管 count=1，但用户影响极度明确: 每个 API 调用都失败，无任何 workaround(用户需手动 monkey-patch child class)。标签含 'priority: high'，6条评论证实影响范围广。满足 P0 的强用户影响证据标准。

source_issues.title: Critical: VertexAI and Bedrock Claude: `_prepare_request_kwargs() got unexpected keyword argument 'messages'` after 2.5.11
source_issues.evidence: TypeError on every API call for VertexAI and Bedrock users after upgrading to 2.5.11; root cause is unupdated child class overrides of _prepare_request_kwargs; 6 comments confirming the issue

signals.topic: E2BTools creates sandbox eagerly in __init__ instead of lazily on first tool call
signals.summary: E2BTools.__init__ immediately calls Sandbox.create() at construction time, causing wasted sandbox resources when tools are never used, duplicate sandboxes on process restarts, and complete incompatibility with AgentOS which requires agents at construction time before any requests are served.
signals.review_reason: 体验显著下降 + 部分阻断: E2BTools 在 AgentOS 场景下完全不可用(eager creation happens before any request is served)，且每次进程重启产生冗余沙箱(浪费资源)。尽管非全局阻断，但 AgentOS 集成失败是明确的用户影响场景。描述的4个问题均有具体机制说明，用户体验损失明显。

source_issues.title: E2BTools creates sandbox eagerly in __init__ instead of lazily on first tool call
source_issues.evidence: 4 distinct user impacts documented: (1) sandbox created before needed, wasting resources; (2) every process restart creates new sandboxes while old ones linger 300s; (3) AgentOS cannot use E2BTools at all since Agent instances trigger __init__ on startup; (4) no cleanup on shutdown causes sandbox accumulation. Reproduction steps confirmed.

signals.topic: AGUI integration does not emit intermediate reasoning content events during streaming
signals.summary: When serving an agent via the AGUI FastAPI router, only STEP_STARTED and STEP_FINISHED events are emitted for the reasoning step, omitting REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT events. Users building AGUI-based UIs cannot display intermediate reasoning steps, limiting the observability and UX of streaming agents.
aliases: AGUI reasoning step only emits start/finish
signals.review_reason: 体验下降: AGUI 用户无法在 UI 中展示推理中间步骤，AGUI 集成的关键价值是流式事件驱动的 UX。证据表明推理内容是可用的(自定义 endpoint 可以 emit 这些事件)，但 AGUI router 没有转发，属于关键功能不完整。但工作流本身仍可完成(只是中间事件丢失)，因此归为 P2。

source_issues.title: AGUI integration does not emit reasoning events
source_issues.evidence: AGUI router only emits STEP_STARTED and STEP_FINISHED for reasoning, omitting REASONING_MESSAGE_CONTENT delta events; user confirms custom endpoint implementation does emit these events correctly, proving the data is available but not forwarded by the AGUI integration

signals.topic: Learning Machine stores messages containing main agent's tool calls and system prompts, causing incorrect tool invocations and prompt leakage

aliases: Learning Machine message parameter includes tool calls
signals.review_reason: 体验下降 + 潜在数据泄露: Learning Machine 存储了不应包含的工具调用和系统提示。两条用户影响: (1) 存储层错误调用不存在的工具，(2) 系统提示泄露给存储层。尽管证据描述较为简略，但影响场景明确: memory/knowledge retrieval 系统的数据污染和系统 prompt 泄漏，属于关键功能的正确性问题。归为 P2 因为仅有单条报告且缺乏详细错误日志。

source_issues.title: About Learning Machine

signals.topic: Skill creation fails with Unexpected JsonNode type: ARRAY exception in multipart form data serialization

signals.topic: Streaming SSE error events report status_code=200 instead of actual error code (e.g. 529 for overloaded_error)
signals.summary: When the API returns HTTP 200 on stream start but then emits a SSE error event (overloaded_error, rate_limit_error, etc.), the SDK constructs an APIStatusError with status_code=200 instead of the correct mapped code (529/429/500). This breaks retry and fallback logic in downstream libraries (e.g. pydantic-ai's FallbackModel) that rely on status_code to decide whether to retry.
aliases: SSE error event status code mismatch
signals.review_reason: This is a real production-impact bug where streaming SSE error events carry the wrong HTTP status code. Downstream libraries using status_code for retry/fallback decisions (e.g. pydantic-ai) get incorrect signals. The issue has exact code paths, reproduction steps, and confirmed production impact. Closed with fix merged.

source_issues.title: Mid-stream SSE errors get `status_code=200` instead of the actual error code
source_issues.evidence: Bug report with exact code path analysis. Production impact confirmed: pydantic-ai's FallbackModel checks status_code >= 500 to retry, but overloaded_error has status_code=200 so fallback never fires.

signals.topic: File upload with PathLike object in tuple fails: second if-block for PathLike unreachable
signals.summary: When passing a PathLike object (e.g. Path('foo.txt')) as the second element of a tuple to client.beta.files.upload, the upload fails because in _transform_file the first if-block catches the tuple, making the second if-block that handles reading PathLike contents unreachable.
signals.review_reason: SDK fails to handle documented PathLike input for file uploads, breaking a documented API feature. The bug is precisely traced to unreachable code in _transform_file where the tuple check prevents PathLike handling from executing.

source_issues.title: [BUG] `client.beta.files.upload`  `PathLike` error
source_issues.evidence: Bug with exact code references to _transform_file. Type signatures declare PathLike support for the tuple but the implementation has unreachable code preventing PathLike from being read correctly.

streaming tool_use terminated stop_reason long content
tool input content size limit streaming

signals.topic: toolRunner 不自动传播 container.id 导致迭代中断且 setMessagesParams 补救方案引发无限工具调用循环
